grammar_choice.en_template: Video gaming {{1:is/are}} one of the most {{2:studied/study}} technologies with regard to empathy.

explain: 주어 핵 = Video gaming (단수 동명사구) → is.

grammar_choice.en_template: Because there have been longstanding concerns about the impact of violent video games on youth, much research {{1:has been conducted/has conducted}} over the last couple of decades on the topic.
grammar_choice.ko_full: 폭력적 비디오 게임이 청소년에게 미치는 영향에 대한 오랜 우려가 있었기 때문에, 지난 수십 년 동안 이 주제에 대해 많은 연구가 수행되어 왔다.
explain: research는 conduct의 대상 → 현재완료 수동태 has been conducted.

grammar_choice.en_template: While {{1:measuring/measured}} and documenting the impact of video game violence, scientists have formulated credible explanations of {{2:how/what}} video gaming could affect empathy.
grammar_choice.ko_full: 비디오 게임 폭력의 영향을 측정하고 기록하는 과정에서, 과학자들은 비디오 게임이 공감에 어떻게 영향을 미칠 수 있는지에 대한 신뢰할 만한 설명을 정립해 왔다.
explain: While + 분사구문, 주어(scientists)가 동작 주체 → 능동 measuring.
뒤 절이 완전(affect의 목적어 empathy 존재) + '어떻게' 의미 → how.

grammar_choice.en_template: Part of a normal, healthy reaction to {{1:witnessing/witness}} violent events {{2:is/are}} to feel negative emotions, and to experience physiological arousal that is connected to fear or disgust.
grammar_choice.ko_full: 폭력적 사건을 목격하는 것에 대한 정상적이고 건강한 반응의 일부는, 부정적 감정을 느끼고 두려움이나 혐오와 연결된 생리적 각성을 경험하는 것이다.

grammar_choice.en_template: With repeated exposure to violent events — such as what might happen when a person plays violent video games — this normal reaction might {{1:become/becomes}} blunted, a phenomenon {{2:known/knowing}} as desensitization.
grammar_choice.ko_full: 폭력적 사건에 반복적으로 노출되면 — 사람이 폭력적 비디오 게임을 할 때 일어날 수 있는 것처럼 — 이 정상적 반응이 무뎌질 수 있는데, 이는 둔감화로 알려진 현상이다.

grammar_choice.en_template: The next step in this problematic process would be {{1:having/have}} diminished emotional responses to violence, {{2:which/that}} could also interfere with the ability to recognize and/or to sympathize with others, {{3:leading/led}} to reduced empathy.

explain: 앞 절 전체를 받는 계속적 용법 → which (that 불가).

grammar_choice.en_template: A significant body of work {{1:shows/show}} an association {{2:between/among}} extensive violent video gaming and reduced empathy in people.

jumble.answer: Video gaming is one of the most studied technologies with regard to empathy.
Because there have been longstanding concerns about the impact of violent video games on youth, much research has been conducted over the last couple of decades on the topic.
While measuring and documenting the impact of video game violence, scientists have formulated credible explanations of how video gaming could affect empathy.
Part of a normal, healthy reaction to witnessing violent events is to feel negative emotions, and to experience physiological arousal that is connected to fear or disgust.
With repeated exposure to violent events — such as what might happen when a person plays violent video games — this normal reaction might become blunted, a phenomenon known as desensitization.

The next step in this problematic process would be having diminished emotional responses to violence, which could also interfere with the ability to recognize and/or to sympathize with others, leading to reduced empathy.
A significant body of work shows an association between extensive violent video gaming and reduced empathy in people.
